content.text:
I've submitted index 28 (Ni 0.157 / Sb 0.844) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.089%, the highest of the three I measured.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 19 | 0.661 | 0.037 |
| 24 | 0.788 | 0.065 |
| 28 | 0.844 | 0.089 |

- **Why these three:** I started at index 19 because it sits at the NiSb₂O₆ composition, the known Ni–Sb oxide photoanode material. It turned out to be the weakest of the three.
- **The trend:** EQE rose steadily with Sb content. Index 28 is the most Sb-rich composition in the library, so the best point I could measure sits at the end of the line.
- **Limits:** that was the whole merit budget of 3. The Ni-rich half (indices 0–15) was never measured; I ruled it out because EQE was falling in that direction. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phase gives the higher EQE is unconfirmed.
